download_muirbench_dataset: download the MUIRBench dataset from HuggingFace and save prompts and images to a local directory
load_muirbench_prompts: load MUIRBench prompts from a local directory and return a dictionary mapping IDs to prompt data
download_muirbench_force: force re-download the MUIRBench dataset from HuggingFace even if data already exists locally
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how MUIRBench images and prompts are saved to disk
review_load_prompts_function: review the load_prompts function to understand how interleaved image and text content is reconstructed
